title: The constructed algebra-valued derived Hom adjunction
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $B$ be a commutative algebra sheaf on $Y$ whose underlying structure-sheaf module is quasi-coherent [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], and assume the chosen derived categories $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ and $D(B)$ exist [def-pc-derived-category], with arbitrary morphism universes. For the explicit algebra-valued derived Hom functor $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Y}(B,-)$ of [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module], there is an adjunction from the rightDerivedFunctor of scalar restriction along $B.hom$ to this constructed functor. This asserts no quasi-coherence or boundedness of its values, and assumes no finiteness or Noetherianity.

source.place: Tags 0BV0 and 0BV1; their argument for general algebra sheaves using Modules Tag 0A6F and Derived Categories Tag 09T5

proof.text: Let F be restriction of scalars along the ring-sheaf morphism induced by B.hom. Install PreservesFiniteLimits F and PreservesFiniteColimits F using sheafAlgebraRestrictScalars_preservesFiniteLimits and sheafAlgebraRestrictScalars_preservesFiniteColimits. Obtain adj: F.mapDerivedCategory left adjoint to derivedRHomAlgebraModule Y B hB from sheafAlgebra_mapDerivedCategory_adjunction (now proved by deriving the smaller underived adjunction and explicitly comparing the resolution localization). Apply adj.ofNatIsoLeft F.rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory.symm to obtain exactly the stated adjunction.

theorem sheafAlgebraDerivedHom_adjunction
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (B : Y.CommAlgebraSheaf) (hB : B.toModule.IsQuasicoherent)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wB} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B.right))] :
    Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u}
      ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map B.hom)).rightDerivedFunctor ⊣
          derivedRHomAlgebraModule Y B hB)
